events.name: Hot Wheels Stunt Show
events.info: Watch as world-class drivers take Hot Wheels vehicles through a series of stunt challenges, with each competition getting more difficult and even more epic. Witness iconic Hot Wheels cars, Street Bikes, and ATV?s execute precision driving skills, backflips, ramp jumps, take on the iconic 45-feet-tall 360-loop and more! Featuring interactive fan experiences, larger-than-life Hot Wheels displays, and special appearances by legendary Hot Wheels vehicles including GT Scorcher, Boneshaker, Rodger Dodger and more. Hot Wheels Stunt Show is the next-level experience for fans of all ages. Whether you're a die-hard collector or a young challenger dreaming of racing glory, this show is a must-see, edge-of-your-seat experience ? for audiences of all ages.
events.pleaseNote: Kids ages 2 years and up must have a ticket. Kids tickets are valid for ages 2 to 12. Kids under 2 are free on a parents lap.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Friday 10:00am-3:00pm. Day of event - Will Call is available 1 hour prior to the start of performance
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tennessee Theatre is a digital ticketing venue. The Box Office will be available 1 hour prior to performance to assist with ticketing needs.

venues.parkingDetail: Free parking is available for most night and weekend performances at the State Street garage located behind the theater, as well as the nearby Locust Street and Market Square garages. Additional parking lots and on-street parking are located nearby. For performances during regular business hours, parking is available in all of these areas for a fee. Parking fees vary from lot to lot. Please allow ample time to park.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The venue has ADA seating in various locations. Please call venue Box Office for these. Venue has Elevators, and ADA Facilities, ADA Parking, ADA ramps and Entrance. For more info call 865-684-1200 ext. 2.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras, camera phones, audio, video and digital recorders, paging devices, and cell phones may not be permitted in the theatres based on the artists' policies. Guests using prohibited items may be ejected without refund.
generalInfo.childRule: All attendees, regardless of age, are required to hold a ticket. This applies to children who may sit on an adult's lap for the majority or entirety of a performance. For question, please contact the Box Office.

venues.name: Bijou Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For ticket purchases or show-related inquiries, please contact the Tennessee Theatre Box Office at 865-684-1200, option 2. For other inquires, please call 865-522-0832.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Bijou Theatre doors typically open one hour prior to showtime and tickets can be purchased at Will Call. Advance tickets can be purchased from the Tennessee Theatre Box Office during business hours
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call can be picked up inside the Bijou Theatre lobby the day of the performance typically one hour prior to the performance. Please have photo ID ready for ticket retrieval.

venues.parkingDetail: Several parking lots and on-street metered spaces are located within walking distance of the Bijou Theatre. The closest parking is a pay lot, Republic Parking, next to the venue on Cumberland. The State Street, Market Square, Dwight Kessel, and Locust Street garages are free after 6 p.m. on weekdays and all day on weekends.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Bijou Theatre has ADA seating in the lower level only. The venue does not have an elevator to the balcony level. For more information, please call the Bijou Theatre at 865-522-0832.

generalInfo.generalRule: Weapons of any kind, including pocketknives; outside food and beverages; smoking of any kind, including e-cigarettes; illegal substances; professional or flash photography, tripods, selfie-sticks; backpacks, bags, oversized purses, etc. are prohibited at the venue. Clear bags are not required. For the safety and security of all patrons, all persons and items entering the Bijou Theatre are subject to search. The Bijou Theatre reserves the right to prohibit any item, including items not listed above, from entering the premises based on any particular show request or requirement. A variety of beverages and snacks are sold at concessions and are allowed in the auditorium. We are a cashless venue.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children aged 2 and up will require a ticket. Children under age 2 that will not be occupying a seat do not need to purchase a ticket. Most events held at the Bijou Theatre are appropriate for all ages. If an age requirement is required, it will be noted on the event description. Contact our box office for more information.
